what: M6 Part B: offline RL on real logged fourth downs

hypotheses.R1_fqi_claims_where_data_is_thin: On real data, tabular FQI's claimed Q(go) exceeds the solved model's Q*(go) most in the states where go is almost never logged (long distance in the own half), and its policy goes for it in some of those states; CQL's claimed Q(go) is below the model's there.
hypotheses.R2_cql_close_to_coaches: CQL's recommended policy agrees with the coaches' most common action in more logged decisions than FQI's and the plug-in's, and the plug-in agrees with the solved model's optimum more than FQI does.
hypotheses.R3_ope_is_too_noisy: On 2024 to 2025, importance-sampling estimates for policies that depart from coaches are very noisy: for most methods the 90% interval of (estimated value minus the logged return) includes zero, and the effective sample size is a small fraction of the drives.
